name: Menu
description: Menu / dropdown popup surface (ui/menu.tsx, XL = jL + KEt): popover ground, 8px radius, 0.5px border-2, shadow-overlay, p 4, min-w 128, max-h min(60dvh, available). Fill the rows slot with Menu Row, Menu Label and Menu Separator. Opens scale .97→1 + fade, 150ms ease-out-quint.
css:
.menu {font-family:var(--font-sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;letter-spacing:var(--tracking-snug);box-sizing:border-box;--sh-card:0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0/.3);--sh-plate:0 .5px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0/.3);--sh-overlay:0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0/.13),0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0/.13),0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0/.13);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:128px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:.5rem;border:var(--spacing-hairline) solid var(--color-border-2);background:var(--color-popover);padding:4px;color:var(--color-foreground);box-shadow:var(--sh-overlay)}
:where([data-doop-theme="light"]) .menu {--sh-card:0 0 0 .5px rgb(0 0 0/.11);--sh-plate:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.05);--sh-overlay:0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0/.03),0 3px 9px rgb(0 0 0/.04),0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0/.05);}
